import numpy as np
base=[np.ones_like(t),t,P,P**2,1/P,t*P,t/P]
def score(extra):

    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A.T if False else np.column_stack(base+extra),dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((np.column_stack(base+extra)@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def fitw(w, cols_names):
    feats={"1":np.ones_like(t),"t":t,"P":P,"P2":P**2,"1/P":1/P,"tP":t*P,"t/P":t/P,"sin/P":np.sin(w*t)/P,"cos/P":np.cos(w*t)/P,"t2":t**2,"sqrtt":np.sqrt(t),"tP2":t*P**2,"sin":np.sin(w*t),"cos":np.cos(w*t)}
    A=np.column_stack([feats[n] for n in cols_names])
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c
